title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Private Partnership Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Private Partnership Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXIX OF 2017
ACT XXIX OF 2017
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PUBLIC PRIVATE
PARTNERSHIP (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Public Private Partnership Act, 2014
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
25th October, 2017]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills / 2017 / 10138, dated 15.10.2017.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Private
Partnership (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 18th October, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of
the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 20th October, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Private
Partnership Act, 2014 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XX of 2014), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enabled as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Private Partnership (Amendment)
Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

It

3. Amendment
of section 32 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XX of 2014.---In the said Act, in section 32, for subsection
(2), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(2)
The proponent shall be invited to participate in the selection proceedings
initiated by the Contracting Authority pursuant to subsection (1) and shall be
given the first right to match the lowest bid and if he fails to match the bid,
the Contracting Authority shall direct the best bidder to reimburse to him the
reasonable costs incurred on project preparation as may be specified in the bid
document".
